```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(comment = '', echo = FALSE)

cat_file <- function(key, n = -1L) {
  f <- snakemake@input[[key]]
  if (is.null(f) || !file.exists(f)) { cat("Not produced by this run.\n"); return(invisible()) }
  txt <- readLines(f, warn = FALSE)
  if (length(txt) == 0) { cat("Empty.\n"); return(invisible()) }
  if (n > 0) txt <- head(txt, n)
  cat(txt, sep = "\n")
}

plot_if <- function(pattern, caption) {
  d <- snakemake@params[["merqury_dir"]]
  fs <- if (dir.exists(d)) list.files(d, pattern = pattern, full.names = TRUE) else character(0)
  if (length(fs) == 0) return(invisible())
  cat("\n\n**", caption, "**\n\n", sep = "")
  for (f in sort(fs)) cat("![](", f, ")\n\n", sep = "")
}
is_trio <- identical(snakemake@params[["mode"]], "trio")
```

# Asm4pg assembly report: `r snakemake@params[["sample"]]`

## Parameters

| | |
|---|---|
| Hifiasm mode | `r snakemake@params[["mode"]]` |
| Parent/run 1 | `r snakemake@params[["r1"]]` |
| Parent/run 2 | `r snakemake@params[["r2"]]` |
| Hifiasm purge force (`-l`) | `r snakemake@params[["assembly_purge_force"]]` |
| purge_dups run | `r if (isTRUE(snakemake@params[["purge_dups_bool"]])) "Yes" else "No"` |
| Scaffolded with RagTag | `r if (isTRUE(snakemake@params[["ragtag_bool"]])) "Yes" else "No"` |
| Lineage | `r snakemake@params[["busco_lineage"]]` |
| Ploidy | `r snakemake@params[["ploidy"]]` |
| k-mer size | `r snakemake@params[["kmer_size"]]` |

## Raw reads

### Read statistics
```{r}
cat_file("genometools_on_raw_data")
```

### Genome profile (GenomeScope)
Estimated from the k-mer histogram *before* assembly.

```{r}
cat_file("genomescope_sum")
```

![](`r snakemake@input[["genomescope"]]`)

## K-mer evaluation (Merqury)

### Consensus quality (QV)
Log-scaled base accuracy, higher is better.

```{r}
cat_file("merqury_qv")
```

### K-mer completeness
Fraction of read k-mers present in the assembly.

```{r}
cat_file("merqury_stats")
```

### Copy-number spectra

```{r results='asis'}
plot_if("hap1\\.spectra-cn\\.fl\\.png$", "Hap 1")
plot_if("hap2\\.spectra-cn\\.fl\\.png$", "Hap 2")
plot_if("^[^.]*\\.spectra-asm\\.fl\\.png$", "Both haplotypes together")
```

```{r results='asis'}
if (is_trio) {
  cat("### Haplotype phasing (trio)\n\n",
      "Each contig placed by how many k-mers it carries from each parent. ", sep = "")
  plot_if("blob\\.png$", "Parental k-mer blob plot")
}
```
